list.title: Steins;Gate
list.description: A group of friends invent a microwave that can send emails to the past, entangling them in a conspiracy surrounding SERN and the fate of humanity.

list.title: Clannad
list.description: Tomoya Okazaki is a delinquent who finds his life changing after meeting Nagisa Furukawa, a girl repeating her senior year due to illness.

list.title: Doki Doki Literature Club!
list.description: Join the Literature Club! It's always been a dream of yours to make something special out of the things you love.

list.title: Muv-Luv Alternative
list.description: Takeru wakes up three years after the end of Unlimited to find himself back in his room. He must use his knowledge to save humanity from the BETA.

list.title: Fate/stay night
list.description: Shirou Emiya finds himself thrust into the Fifth Holy Grail War, a secret magical tournament where participants fight to the death for a wish-granting chalice.
